subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom in the given sentence.

The two neighbours will probably stop fighting __when pigs fly .__
solution: The correct answer is** Option 3)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"when pigs fly"** means something that is highly unlikely or impossible to happen. (असंभव) • **Example: **He will apologize to you **when pigs fly.** • **"Impossible"** refers to something that cannot happen or be done. (असंभव) • **Example: **It's** impossible** to finish this project in one day. Therefore, the correct meaning of the given idiom is** 'Something that is impossible.'** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **When their families meet** (जब उनके परिवार मिलते हैं): Refers to the scenario when the families of the neighbors meet. • **Example:** The neighbors might resolve their issues **when their families meet.** • **When there is magic** (जब जादू होता है): Refers to the occurrence of a magical event. • **Example: **He'll finish his homework on time **when there is magic.** • **When it rains** (जब बारिश होती है): Refers to the occurrence of rainfall. • **Example: **We will play outside** when it rains.** 20a:Tcc3, The correct answer is **Option 2)**
